signature.name: Ibirapuera Park
signature.detail: São Paulo's most famous park and a must-see for its green space, museums and lakes. Go early on a weekday to avoid crowds; it's free and easily reached by metro and bus.

signature.name: São Paulo Museum of Art
signature.detail: Home to one of Latin America's finest art collections and an iconic modernist building on Paulista Avenue. Closed on Mondays; check ticket prices online and arrive early on weekends.

signature.name: Paulista Avenue
signature.detail: The city's main artery, packed with museums, shops and cultural institutions. Visit on a Sunday when the avenue is closed to cars and becomes a lively open street.

signature.name: Mercado Municipal de Sao Paulo
signature.detail: A historic market famous for its stained-glass windows and local foods like mortadella sandwiches and pastel. Go on a weekday morning for fewer crowds; bring cash for snacks.

signature.name: Sao Paulo Cathedral
signature.detail: One of the world's largest neo-Gothic cathedrals, right in the historic center. Visit during daylight hours and keep an eye on your belongings in the surrounding square.

signature.name: Theatro Municipal
signature.detail: A beautifully restored early 20th-century opera house modeled on Parisian theaters. Guided tours are available; check the schedule for performances and book in advance.

signature.name: Liberdade
signature.detail: The heart of São Paulo's Japanese community, with street markets and Asian restaurants. Go on a weekend for the lively street fair; it's easily reached by metro.

signature.name: Batman Alley
signature.detail: A colorful open-air street-art gallery in Vila Madalena, perfect for photos. Visit during the day and combine with a stroll through the surrounding Vila Madalena district.

signature.name: Museum of the Portuguese Language
signature.detail: An engaging museum housed in a historic building near the cathedral, dedicated to the Portuguese language. Check opening hours; it's closed on Mondays.

signature.name: Pinacoteca do Estado
signature.detail: A leading art museum in a striking historic building with a strong collection of Brazilian art. Closed on Mondays; tickets are affordable and the surrounding area is worth exploring.

transport: Metro $1-1.50 a ride; taxis and rideshares moderate
